messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.34-2 released on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
NMOF 0.34-2 is now available from CRAN and from
http://enricoschumann.net/R/packages/NMOF/index.htm .

The NEWS entry:

v0.34-2  (2015-05-05)

  o fixed: 'DEopt' did not properly handle the 'minmaxConstr' option,
    which could result in solutions that violated the box constraints.
    (Thanks to David Ashear for reporting.)



-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
